summary: Comprehensive Revised Implementation Plan addressing the 3 user requirements: (1) Physical Stock Check & bin location logging in Stage 2 for zero-inventory setup and daily audit prep; (2) Complete removal of Estimated Rate and Total Amount from Stage 1 Requisition (rates fluctuate daily and belong only in downstream CS/PO); (3) Stage-wise Quantity Revision (Requester -> Store In-Charge -> Purchaser) with reason tracking and 3-way triage (Store Dispatch, Purchase Indent, Hold) with automated sub-workflow spawning.
